Control settings for finite-mixture and latent-class count models

Source: R/mixture_spec.R
mixture_control.Rd

Settings of the estimation algorithm used by countreg_mix() and countreg_lc(). lc_control() is the same function under the name used with the latent-class interface; both return the same object.

Usage

mixture_control(
  algorithm = c("em", "direct"),
  em_maxit = 200L,
  em_tol = 1e-06,
  mstep_maxit = 25L,
  n_polish = 3L,
  boot_starts = 5L,
  small_class = 0.05,
  start_spread = 0.5
)

lc_control(...)

Arguments

algorithm

"em" (default): each start is improved by the expectation-maximization (EM) algorithm, and the best solutions are then polished by maximizing the observed-data log-likelihood directly (with the optimizer chosen by method). "direct": every start is maximized directly, without EM iterations.

em_maxit

maximum number of EM iterations per start.

em_tol

relative convergence tolerance of the EM iterations. EM stops when the relative change in the observed log-likelihood is below em_tol and the largest change in a parameter is below sqrt(em_tol).

mstep_maxit

maximum number of quasi-Newton iterations in each numerical M-step (a generalized EM step: it need not reach the conditional maximum, but it must increase the likelihood).

n_polish

number of distinct EM solutions (the best ones) that are polished by direct maximization.

boot_starts

number of starts used in each refit of a bootstrap (stderr = "boot"), in addition to the original estimates.

small_class

posterior class share below which a component is flagged as small in the output. This is a reporting threshold only: it never changes the fit.

start_spread

spread of the response-based starting partitions (the standard deviation, in units of the standardized score, of the noise added to the score that orders the units into starting classes).

...

arguments passed from lc_control() to mixture_control().

Value

An object of class fcr_mixture_control.

See also

countreg_mix(), countreg_lc()

Examples

mixture_control(em_maxit = 200)
#> Finite-mixture control settings
#>   algorithm : em 
#>   em_maxit : 200 
#>   em_tol : 1e-06 
#>   mstep_maxit : 25 
#>   n_polish : 3 
#>   boot_starts : 5 
#>   small_class : 0.05 
#>   start_spread : 0.5 
lc_control(algorithm = "direct")
#> Finite-mixture control settings
#>   algorithm : direct 
#>   em_maxit : 200 
#>   em_tol : 1e-06 
#>   mstep_maxit : 25 
#>   n_polish : 3 
#>   boot_starts : 5 
#>   small_class : 0.05 
#>   start_spread : 0.5
